subject: Chemistry
questionText: Match the coordination complexes in Column I with their geometric hybridization and magnetic properties in Column II:

column2: Q. $d^2 sp^3$ / Octahedral, Paramagnetic (1 unpaired electron)

solution:
A -> Q ($d^2sp^3$, low spin octahedral, $\text{Fe}^{3+} (d^5)$ 1 unpaired e-).
B -> R ($sp^3$, tetrahedral, $\text{Ni}^0 (d^{10})$ diamagnetic).
C -> S ($dsp^2$, square planar, $\text{Ni}^{2+} (d^8)$ strong field ligand $\text{CN}^-$ pairing).
D -> T ($sp^3$, tetrahedral, $\text{Mn}^{2+} (d^5)$ weak field $\text{Cl}^-$ high spin).
